description: Cybersecurity teaches you to protect yourself and your devices: online safety and ethics, what attackers target, common threats like malware and phishing, practical defenses such as strong passwords, multi-factor authentication and backups, and the basics of cryptography.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. The excerpt was cut off partway through requirement 6; any later requirements are not outlined yet.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Safety
requirements.summary: Your digital footprint, privacy settings and the physical effects of device use.

requirements.title: Ethics
requirements.summary: Applying the Scout Law online and handling situations such as an unlocked device or exposed password.

requirements.title: Attack surface
requirements.summary: The systems and information that need protecting and why.

requirements.title: Threats and attacks
requirements.summary: Vulnerabilities, threats and exploits, malware, public Wi-Fi risks, and phishing and spoofing.

requirements.title: Cyber defenses
requirements.summary: Defensive technologies and hands-on steps such as strong passwords, multi-factor authentication, updates, scans and backups.

requirements.title: Cryptography
requirements.summary: Encryption, checking for an encrypted connection, and making or using a cipher.
